title: Lyn Buchanan met with an alien as a remote viewer

tellings.quote: Lynn Buchanan, who I've known for a long time, the Army remote viewer. Yeah. He told me like I don't know eight or nine years ago that he had met with an alien.

plain: Lyn Buchanan, a remote viewer for the US Army, meaning someone trained to try to see distant places with the mind alone, is said to have met with an alien, probably on a military base. Greg Bishop, a guest who says he has known Buchanan for a long time, tells it as something Buchanan told him personally "eight or nine years ago", around 2016. If true, it would mean military psychic programmes put people face to face with non-human beings.
